facts.text: Mowgli, grab a paw full of those ripe pawpaws and pass me the ants. Dinner is better eaten lying on your back.
facts.why: Baloo never says this. It reads like a mash of song lyrics. His real lines include 'Man Village? They'll ruin 'im! They'll make a man out of 'im!'
facts.fix: Man Village? They'll ruin 'im! They'll make a man out of 'im!

vibe.verdict: The Indian dishes suit the film, but the tiki island layout (pupu platters, island map) is a different world from the Indian jungle.
missing: The Bare Necessities (prickly pear, ants, bananas, the river float)
King Louie wanting to learn how to make fire (the temple)
The vultures and Shere Khan's burning tail (the wastelands)
Mowgli meeting the girl at the river (man village)
ideas: Swap the 'Pupu Platters' and 'Island hopping' headings for jungle ones like 'The Bare Necessities' and 'King Louie's Temple'
Swap 'Vegetable pakoras with tamarind chutney' note for a line from Baloo about the prickly pear
Swap 'Baloo's banana bites' for 'Bare necessities, ants and all' to name the song moment
Replace the blue ocean island map with a jungle river map, Mowgli and Baloo floating on the water
